prompt: Create ONE production UI icon atlas for a cozy ocean fishing game. Transparent background. Warm softly shaded miniature storybook game item artwork, amber brown outlines, turquoise and peach accents, dimensional shading, instantly recognizable even at 40px. Row 1 left to right: 1 fishing rod with a tiny sun (daily fishing); 2 fishing hook slipping out of a small fish mouth with motion marks (miss); 3 seashell decoration on a tiny stand (decorations); 4 small bucket with fishing net collecting a discarded bottle (beach cleanup); 5 gold coin with a sparkling game controller (arcade winnings). Row 2 left to right: 6 open empty coin purse beside a game token (arcade spending); 7 bent but unbroken fishing rod with a small knot (persistence); 8 cheerful heart shaped fan badge (likes); 9 steaming cartoon potato (controversial); 10 helping hand holding a small sea star (helping friends). Each of the ten objects distinct, high quality detailed but clean, no people or background scenery. All cells equal, precisely aligned five across two down.
